record.title: Amatal deliberate vehicle-access blockade on San Cristóbal frontier route, November2019
record.scope: Specified vehicular approach to San Cristóbal frontier; cross-border vehicles prevented from reaching customs. Not an assertion that every access route or border admission category closed.
record.crossings: Amatal bridge, km165.5, route to San Cristóbal crossing
record.direction: Vehicles using Guatemalan approach to/from San Cristóbal; complete direction-specific admission scope unresolved.
record.movement: Cargo and other vehicles on named approach; perishable goods and Salvadoran traders affected.
record.exceptions: Pedestrians permitted; alternate routes advised. Customs legal operations not shown suspended.
record.imposing_authority: Residents of Jutiapa communities and participating transport protesters
record.enforcement: Deliberate resident obstruction with vehicle queues; PNC and customs statements connect obstruction to non-arrival of transport at San Cristóbal.
record.consequences: Trade disruption and stranded vehicles; no quantified independent loss estimate adopted.
record.relationship: Promotion of held R11-AM-L002 after applying intentional-access-blockade scope consistently with R3-AM-008; distinct from R11-AM-001/R11-AM-002 May2019 DUCA trucker episodes.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Residents and participating transport protesters demanded reconstruction of the poor road; reported public-services/livelihood demand.
record.context: Residents intentionally blocked Amatal bridge to pressure authorities for repairs. Deliberate blockade, not roadworks outage.
record.uncertainty: Distance reported as5km in early report and1.5km in reopening article. Road reopening November8 reported10:40; worker header6:21AM differs from reviewer header12:21PM, so this is rendering uncertainty rather than proven event-time contradiction. Later AmCham story may repeat stale concerns. No exact continuous interval or whole-frontier closure inferred.

historical.duration_note: Not calculated; conservative endpoint remains unknown.
